v.t: When there comes God’s victory, and conquest
v.l: Idha Ja'a Nasru Allahi Wa Al-Fathu

v.t: And you see the people entering God’s religion in multitudes
v.l: Wa Ra'ayta An-Nasa Yadkhuluna Fi Dini Allahi 'Afwajaan

v.t: Then celebrate the praise of your Lord, and seek His forgiveness. He is the Accepter of Repentance
v.l: Fasabbih Bihamdi Rabbika Wa Astaghfirhu 'Innahu Kana Tawwabaan
